parameters.query:
WITH staging_stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*)::integer AS total_chunks,

        COUNT(
            DISTINCT metadata ->> 'document_id'
        )::integer AS document_count,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE embedding IS NULL
        )::integer AS null_embedding_count,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE text IS NULL
               OR BTRIM(text) = ''
        )::integer AS empty_text_count,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE metadata IS NULL
               OR COALESCE(
                    BTRIM(metadata ->> 'document_id'),
                    ''
               ) = ''
        )::integer AS missing_document_id_count,

        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE metadata IS NULL
               OR COALESCE(
                    BTRIM(metadata ->> 'chunk_index'),
                    ''
               ) = ''
        )::integer AS missing_chunk_index_count
    FROM public.langchain_document_chunks_staging
),
duplicate_stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*)::integer
            AS duplicate_chunk_key_count
    FROM (
        SELECT
            metadata ->> 'document_id'
                AS document_id,
            metadata ->> 'chunk_index'
                AS chunk_index
        FROM public.langchain_document_chunks_staging
        WHERE COALESCE(
                  BTRIM(metadata ->> 'document_id'),
                  ''
              ) <> ''
          AND COALESCE(
                  BTRIM(metadata ->> 'chunk_index'),
                  ''
              ) <> ''
        GROUP BY
            metadata ->> 'document_id',
            metadata ->> 'chunk_index'
        HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
    ) AS duplicate_chunks
)
SELECT
    staging_stats.*,
    duplicate_stats.duplicate_chunk_key_count,

    (
        staging_stats.total_chunks > 0
        AND staging_stats.null_embedding_count = 0
        AND staging_stats.empty_text_count = 0
        AND staging_stats.missing_document_id_count = 0
        AND staging_stats.missing_chunk_index_count = 0
        AND duplicate_stats.duplicate_chunk_key_count = 0
    ) AS is_valid

FROM staging_stats
CROSS JOIN duplicate_stats;

parameters.query:
TRUNCATE TABLE
    public.langchain_document_chunks;

INSERT INTO public.langchain_document_chunks (
    id,
    text,
    metadata,
    embedding,
    collection_id
)
SELECT
    id,
    text,
    metadata,
    embedding,
    collection_id
FROM public.langchain_document_chunks_staging;

SELECT
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)::integer
        FROM public.langchain_document_chunks
    ) AS active_chunk_count,

    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)::integer
        FROM public.langchain_document_chunks_staging
    ) AS staging_chunk_count,

    (
        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM public.langchain_document_chunks
        )
        =
        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM public.langchain_document_chunks_staging
        )
    ) AS counts_match,

    NOW() AS promoted_at;

nodes.name: Promote Staging to Active
nodes.notes: Replaces the active vector data with the validated staging chunks.
